tasks: - userTask("Confirm Contract") - Couple signs contract covering all services
- userTask("Confirm Details") - Couple confirms ceremony time, guest count, room assignments, menu selections, dietary restrictions, beverage selections, music/DJ arrangement
- userTask("Create Master Timeline") - Coordinator creates master timeline and coordinates across departments
- userTask("Confirm Final Headcount") - Final headcount confirmed
- userTask("Confirm Room Block") - Room block confirmed
- userTask("Finalize Dietary Restrictions") - Dietary restrictions list finalized
- userTask("Reserve AV Equipment") - AV equipment reserved
- userTask("Finalize Seating Chart") - Seating chart finalized
- userTask("Prepare Name Placards") - Name placards prepared
- userTask("Prepare Kitchen Plans") - Kitchen plans prep timeline
- userTask("Calculate Alcohol Quantities") - Bar manager calculates alcohol quantities
- userTask("Morning Setup") - Ceremony room arranged, reception tables arranged, AV tested
- userTask("Ceremony") - Ceremony begins at scheduled time
- userTask("Reception") - Guest check-in, catering service begins, bar opens, dancing begins, bar closes at midnight
- userTask("Immediate Cleanup") - Furniture removed, room reset
- userTask("Guest Checkout") - Guest checkout next morning with luggage storage available
- userTask("Final Billing") - Final billing reconciles actual charges against estimated invoice
gateways: - XOR at point X with conditions A, B, default
- AND at point Y with N parallel branches
boundary_events: - timerBoundary on Task X - SLA: [explicit requirement]
- errorBoundary on Task Y - Error: [explicit scenario]
